entry.control_detail: control_<cell>.json per cell: 10 EN_MODERN + 10 EN_NOVOWEL per relation (40 natural-rate plants), enciphered from the TRUE K_raw[offset:] with the TRUE sign, through the real 2^16-seed chunk path; recoveries o0_sp 39/40, o1_sm 40/40, o2_sm 39/40, o3_sm 40/40, o28_sm 40/40 (the 2 losses are pf_v4_12 screen misses); X1 recomputed every plant against the bar of record at N=1e6 (L120 10.4645/10.4856, L240 10.0529/10.3539; min plant pmax120 14.3, pmax240 19.4): the recoveries and the >=3-per-split gate are unchanged. X1 independent re-plant (own bash 4.2 generator, own enciphering and head wrapper): offset 2 sign -1 4/5 recovered (the loss a screen miss), offset 0 sign +1 5/5. Misaligned negative control, relation-specific (B2 20 plants + X1 re-plants, EN_MODERN/EN_NOVOWEL, bash 4.2 LP64, offset-k plants screened and decoded at the offset-0 alignment of every earlier orbit sweep): offset 1 under keyskip1 recovers 10/15 (Wilson 95% [0.42, 0.85]), under keyskip2 0/15 ([0, 0.2]); offset 2 under keyskip2 3/5 and under keyskip1 1/5 (X1, n=5 each, intervals wide); sign +1 plants (offset 0) under the sign -1 instrument 0/10 ([0, 0.28]). Pooling the relations (B2's 6/20, 'roughly 0.3') hides this: the keyskip-a relation absorbs a start-of-stream key shift of a as a key skip (inferred from the pattern, not separately tested). Offsets 3 and 28 not measured this way. Controls cover EN_MODERN and EN_NOVOWEL only.
entry.hypothesis: The LP2 key is the bash 4.2 LP64 auto-seed $RANDOM%29 stream with the first k draws discarded (k = 1, 2, 3 swept; 28 not run) and/or with the decode sign +1 (offset 0), <= 2 key skips in the first 24 runes, plaintext in one of the 12 panel-R36 registers.
entry.coverage: Cells run in the pre-registered prior-weighted order. offset 0, sign +1: 296/296 chunks (77594624 seeds, 100.0% of the orbit), 65314 survivors, each decoded under both relations; offset 1, sign -1: 296/296 chunks (77594624 seeds, 100.0% of the orbit), 65229 survivors, each decoded under both relations; offset 2, sign -1: 296/296 chunks (77594624 seeds, 100.0% of the orbit), 65358 survivors, each decoded under both relations; offset 3, sign -1: 143/296 chunks (37486592 seeds, 48.3% of the orbit), 31731 survivors, each decoded under both relations. Offset 28 (sign -1) was NOT run (cap). Of the 58-cell LP64 offset x sign axis: 1 cell done by R37-I2 (offset 0, sign -1), 3 full + 0.48 of a cell here, 53 cells untouched (91.4% of the LP64 axis). Counting ILP32 (never run at a non-zero offset) the axis is 116 cells: (0,-1) both ABIs + 3 LP64 cells + 0.48 = 5.48 cells, 4.7%.
entry.result: 0 flagged, 0 near-miss in any cell, judged against the Round 41 I1 bar of record (bars_v3 family='survivor12', max of the survivor refit and the pooled real-sweep POT line) at actual N and at N=1e6; the null12 bars the lane quoted (8.0-8.1 at actual N, 9.102 / 8.999 at N=1e6) are superseded. offset 0, sign +1 (296/296 chunks): keyskip1 best 6.557 (seed 1351506977, LP1_REAL) vs bar of record 9.344 at actual N=65314 (10.4645 at N=1e6); keyskip2 best 6.588 (seed 1360905550, EN_KJV) vs 9.367 (10.4856 at N=1e6); offset 1, sign -1 (296/296): keyskip1 best 6.831 (seed 1329866581, LP1_REAL) vs bar of record 9.344 at actual N=65229 (10.4645 at N=1e6); keyskip2 best 6.713 (seed 1364795802, LP1_REAL) vs 9.367 (10.4856 at N=1e6); offset 2, sign -1 (296/296): keyskip1 best 6.794 (seed 1399396022, LP1_REAL) vs bar of record 9.345 at actual N=65358 (10.4645 at N=1e6); keyskip2 best 6.696 (seed 1393579878, EN_HALFVOWEL) vs 9.367 (10.4856 at N=1e6); offset 3, sign -1 (143/296 chunks): keyskip1 best 6.348 (seed 1360556499, CY) vs bar of record 9.048 at actual N=31731 (10.4645 at N=1e6); keyskip2 best 6.332 (seed 1370298412, EN_HALFVOWEL) vs 9.071 (10.4856 at N=1e6). Smallest gap to the bar of record: 2.51 at actual N (offset 1 keyskip1, 6.831 vs 9.344) and 3.63 at N=1e6; no L=240 gate decode was needed. The bar of record at N=1e6 is an exponential-tail upper bracket (statistical SE 0.09; a GPD alternative gives about 7.0); no verdict depends on the choice.

three_conditionals.key_space: bash 4.2 LP64 auto-seed orbit (74 x 2^20 seeds), %29, at the cells (0,+1), (1,-1), (2,-1), (3,-1 half); ciphertext C[0] paired with K_raw[offset]; effective key K_raw[k:] (sign -1) or 29-K_raw[k:] (sign +1)
three_conditionals.transition_model: keyskip1+keyskip2 under beam_v3 panel_max, L120 screen / L240 gate; heads with <= 2 skips in 24 runes; not free, not L31
three_conditionals.adjudicator_register: panel-R36, 12 registers; pf_v4_12 reach 0.952-0.994 per register x v3 recovery (this lane's controls: 198/200 end-to-end over EN_MODERN and EN_NOVOWEL only)

entry.not_covered: Offset 28 (sign -1; control passed 40/40, no sweep) and the second half of offset 3; offsets 4-27 at sign -1; offsets 1-28 at sign +1; ILP32 at EVERY offset (the 58-cell axis is LP64 only: with ILP32 it is 116 cells, of which R37-I2's (0,-1) both ABIs = 2, B2's 3 LP64 cells and 0.48 of (3,-1) = 5.48 cells, 4.7%); offsets > 28; an offset that is nondeterministic (depends on shell activity before the first $RANDOM read); heads with >= 3 skips in 24 runes; free relation; L=31; registers outside the twelve (plants cover EN_MODERN and EN_NOVOWEL only); bash versions other than 4.2 at any offset; the head screen ignores the anti-repeat rule (about (24+offset)/32768 of seeds: 0.07% at offset 0, 0.16% at offset 28)
entry.reopens_if: the oracle flags a row; a stated offset or sign is hypothesised with evidence; the remaining cells (28; 4-27; sign +1 offsets) or ILP32 are run.
